video_title: Tristan Thompson on LeBron, Kyrie Irving, Kardashians, Europe Boys Trip & Cavaliers' 2016 NBA Win

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson believes LeBron James should keep playing
quotes.excerpt: I think he should keep the gray hairs out. Imagine you dropping 30 and 10 on a young kid.
quotes.quote: I think he should keep the gray hairs out. Imagine you dropping 30 and 10 on a young kid. You have to reevaluate. If that's my son, you can't have someone with the grays dropping 30 and 10 on you. That is unacceptable.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Love's leadership role in organizing the group trip
quotes.excerpt: I got to give a big shout out to Kevin Love. He put it together.
quotes.quote: I got to give a big shout out to Kevin Love. Kevin Love put it together. If you had to look at your bingo card and guess who would put it together back then, you would have said Kevin Love. Kevin Love has been in Miami. He has been taking that leadership role and he has done the group chat. So I am like, shout out to Kevin Love for doing it. He put his mind to it, got his team together, and we all showed up. It was amazing.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: The lifestyle and travel habits of LeBron James and Kevin Love
quotes.excerpt: You got LeBron James traveling, he's hitting golf balls off a yacht that's probably costing a million dollars.
quotes.quote: If you look at everyone's Instagram, you got LeBron James traveling, he's hitting golf balls off a yacht that's probably costing a million dollars a week. You got Kevin Love, he be jet-setting, you don't know where he's going to be selling pizza or doing whatever. He might be in Iceland getting recovery, and then you got me international. You know, I'll be in the Middle East.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's competitive drive to be the best golfer
quotes.excerpt: He wants to be the best golfer of all time in one year.
quotes.quote: He wants to be the best at everything. And he's trying to be the greatest golfer of all time in one year. It takes time. You got to put a lot of time and effort and energy in that game to be good at it. And yesterday has nothing to do with today and today has nothing to do with tomorrow. You can go out there and play a great round of golf today and tomorrow you be terrible and make you want to quit.

quotes.quote: LeBron James has the power and he's got much better. His swing look much better. Kevin Love is exactly who you think he is. Smith, and Channing Frye is all right because he lives in Portland because he already got good weather. Portland and Scotland is damn near the same weather. They don't really get much sun.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: The enduring brotherhood of the 2016 Cavaliers championship team
quotes.excerpt: We've all been on so many different teams since being with the Cavs and we're still thick as ever.
quotes.quote: We've all been on so many different teams since being with the Cavs and we're still thick as ever. So, that was like, we all had emotional moments where we're like, we don't want this to end. We don't want to go home, man.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's perspective on the Cavaliers' 2016 championship run
quotes.excerpt: I played for Mike Brown. Him singing 'Who Let the Dogs Out' compared to us being chopper three helicopters.
quotes.quote: I played for Mike Brown. Him singing 'Who Let the Dogs Out' compared to us being chopper three helicopters pulling up to a prestigious golf course. Come on now. There's levels. So we got to do it right now. We got to flex.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's confidence in the 2016 Cavaliers beating the Knicks
quotes.excerpt: No one's going to be able to guard Kyrie Irving and LeBron James. Absolutely not.
quotes.quote: No one's going to be able to guard Kyrie Irving and LeBron James. Absolutely not. No one can guard Kyrie Irving. No one can guard Finals LeBron James. 41, 11, and 11. Come on now. That's what we're talking about. And then obviously, J.R. Smith got size, so we're going to put him on Jalen Brunson. And don't worry, like Jalen Brunson going to do his thing, but I think just having those two guys, LeBron James and Kyrie Irving, compared to Jalen Brunson and Jayson Tatum, and we still got Kevin Love. Come on now. Who going to touch Kevin Love?

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's role in the 2016 Cavaliers' defensive strategy
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to come on the defense and I'm going to be in the paint.
quotes.quote: I'm going to come on the defense and I'm going to be in the paint. And Richard Jefferson, he's going to jump for every pump fake. Birdie. He's going to be birdie. Yeah, he's going to be birdie. You know, so no, I'm taking I'm taking our 2016 team. But I mean, yeah, for sure.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's assessment of the 2017-18 Warriors team
quotes.excerpt: The reality is that that 2017-18 Warriors team is a cheat code.
quotes.quote: The reality is that that 2017-18 Warriors team is a cheat code. I mean, they literally made the NBA say, you know what, forget vets, we're going to go all young guys on the bench. I mean, think about when that team came together. Only four teams thought they had a chance to really make a run: Warriors, Rockets, Cavs, and a coin flip of the East team was probably the Celtics because they were just prideful. Everyone else, they just started packing it in and saying like, we're just going to rebuild.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's praise for Kyrie Irving's talent
quotes.excerpt: If Kyrie Irving was two inches taller, he'd be the best player to ever touch a basketball.
quotes.quote: If Kyrie Irving was two inches taller, he'd be the best player to ever touch a basketball and planet Earth. Because think about it, first of all, have you ever seen Kyrie Irving get a shot blocked? Never. And he's only what, 6'2, 6'3. But so imagine he was 6'5, what he could do right now. No, it would be other world. Like even if you ask LeBron James, like Kyrie Irving is probably the most talented. If you put Kyrie Irving in a workout, he could do anything. He has no flaws in his game.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's opinion on Draymond Green's 2016 Finals MVP potential
quotes.excerpt: If they win that, Draymond Green get MVP. He had 30, 10, and 10 or something like that.
quotes.quote: If they win that, Draymond Green get MVP. He had 30, 10, and 10 or something like that. He was one assist or a rebound away from a triple-double.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of having a closer in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: It's so important to have a guard that can close out because you got to be able to give the guy the ball.
quotes.quote: It's so important to have a guard that can close out because you got to be able to give the guy the ball and say go go get a bucket or a foul. It's tough for bigs because the NBA is so different now. You can double team. It's not like when Shaq came. He's just going to duck you in and he's just going to score every time. You need a guy that can catch at the elbow. That's why Jayson Tatum is so valuable. That's why, you know, Luka Doncic will value. You can catch at the elbow and it's either you have nothing, you can have nothing to stop him.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyronn Lue's coaching style and the 2016 Cavaliers' success
quotes.excerpt: Tyronn Lue got hired to coach myself, Kyrie Irving, Dion Waiters, Tyler Zeller. He got hired before LeBron James signed back.
quotes.quote: Tyronn Lue got hired to coach myself, Kyrie Irving, Dion Waiters, Tyler Zeller. He got hired before LeBron James signed back. So he got hired to help this young Cavs team mature to be a playoff team. He didn't get hired for LeBron James and Kevin Love to come in, you know, come be contenders. But the Cavs did a good job because they know David Blatt's coming from EuroLeague and he had multiple EuroLeague. He's like a he's like a Hall of Fame. Like he's a superstar. I mean, he had people coming to games in Miami for him, his own section. So, you bring Tyronn Lue in and I think they the Cavs knew also like, hey, we got David Blatt who has this great potential but then we also have this young whip snapper Tyronn Lue where if things don't go right with Blatt and if we do get a superstar like the LeBron and James to come, we got someone that has credibility with LeBron James, that can kind of like make LeBron James feel comfortable.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's early career and financial growth
quotes.excerpt: I know Kyrie Irving since the 10th grade because you know I went to high school in New Jersey.
quotes.quote: I know Kyrie Irving since the 10th grade because you know I went to high school in New Jersey. So Kyrie from New Jersey as well. So I went to Saint Benedict's Prep in Newark. Shout out to Newark, Market and MLK Street. And then Kyrie went to Saint Pat's. So we were actually rivals. But we know each other because we're in the same high school class. We're in the same circus. So I've known Kyrie since I was 16. So we we did the McDonald's getting together, Hoop Summit, Jordan Brand Classic. He goes to Duke, I go to Texas. So we've always been in contact. So now when we get drafted to Cleveland and um, you know, draft night we get we both get announced, we're going to Cleveland like, yo, let's let's do something special, right? Like, guard, big, let's run it up. Like, because we know at the end of the day, we know how Cleveland is, right? LeBron left, the city is sad, everyone's sad, they need some type of hope. So we come in there and we play well.

quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's perspective on rookie contracts and financial management

You know, I remember Rich and Farrah put me on that one, so that was a good one.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson on the significance of the 2016 Cavaliers championship
quotes.excerpt: It wasn't just about the championship, it was about the people in Cleveland.
quotes.quote: Winning a championship, because you know what? It wasn't just about the championship, it was about the people in Cleveland. I thought about that. Because you know when I got drafted there and Kyrie, all everyone talked about is, 'Are you going to leave us like LeBron?' Or like, we went 52 years without winning a championship. Are we going to ever win a championship, right? So for me, all I thought about was the people in Northeast Ohio. Because that was the people that mattered the most. I remember a gentleman coming up to me, 70-year-old man, crying, like real balling tears, saying, 'Thank you for winning a championship, now I can pass away as a champion.' That's what he said. So that's what he said, so that touched me. It's bigger than us. That championship wasn't just about the Cavs, that was about Northeast Ohio.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson explains his controversial dunk against the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: If it's a minute left in the game, I'm cool with you guys going to score.
quotes.quote: They were double-teaming and guarding us in the last possessions and they were scoring and taking it serious. So all I'm saying is that if it's a minute left in the game, I'm cool with you guys going to like, when you guys get the possession, go score. But if we got the possession, why are you trapping and double-teaming us? Like this ain't AAU where every point counts for the next round. So you guys double-team us, I'm going to dunk the ball.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson's advice on handling a public breakup
quotes.excerpt: The worst thing you could do is feed into the beast.
quotes.quote: I think the worst thing you could do is feed into the beast. If you speak up, you give it more legs. You allow them to take another day to talk about it. You had a relationship with someone, an artist, it didn't work out. If she wants to say something, let her do whatever she wants to do. You keep your mouth quiet. And honestly, as a man, keep your mouth quiet. Because I've never went out there and defended myself because it's just not what we do.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson on the Timberwolves waiving DeAndre Liggins
quotes.excerpt: Most teams, when you end the season on a high like that, you run it back.
quotes.quote: I'm definitely surprised because you know they had one of the best records in the NBA the last half of the season after All-Star weekend, right? So for them to pull that trigger, most teams, when you end the season on a high like that, you run it back or you add some quality vets to take it to the next level. So the fact that they get off him, for me, it's a weird feeling because it's like, aren't you guys trying to make the playoffs? And don't get me wrong, like Kobe White is great, but he was great at coming off the bench for you. You got to keep that going, but who knows what's going on internally.

quotes.speaker: Tristan Thompson
quotes.summary_phrase: Tristan Thompson on leveraging his NBA career for business
quotes.excerpt: Shaq and Magic were one of the two guys that were able to leverage their NIL.
quotes.quote: I look at guys like Shaq and Magic Johnson. Shaq and Magic were one of the two guys that were able to leverage their NIL to open up business for them. And for me, it's like Shaq and Magic, they, you know, much older in age, there's another young guy that needs to take that, take that spot, and that's me. So for me, when I'm doing this, a lot more like venture finance and looking at where the world's going and not where the world's at.
